daily.today_energy: Your vibe is grounded but curious today. There's a pull toward something new—trust that restless feeling. The universe is nudging you toward growth, and your stubborn nature is finally ready to listen.
daily.love: Vulnerability looks good on you rn. If you've been holding back, today's the day to let someone see the real you. Single? That magnetic energy you're giving off isn't going unnoticed.
daily.career: Your ideas hit different today. Don't play small with what you know—speak up in that meeting or pitch that thing you've been sitting on. Your practical approach mixed with fresh thinking is exactly what's needed.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding rituals. Whether it's time in nature, a long shower, or just being offline for a bit—honor that need. Your energy resets when you're intentional about slowing down.

weekly.overview: Mercury's vibes are shifting your perspective this week, Taurus. You're ready to release what no longer serves and make space for something fresh. Trust the timing—your intuition is absolutely locked in right now.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, vulnerability is your superpower this week. Someone might surprise you with their realness, and honestly? That's the energy you've been manifesting. Let your guard down a little.
weekly.career: Your creative solutions are hitting different this week. Don't sleep on that idea you've been sitting with—it's got legs. This is your moment to show what you're capable of without needing external validation.
weekly.health: Your body's asking you to slow down and actually listen to it. Movement that feels good (not punishing) is calling your name. Rest isn't laziness; it's you honoring your vessel. Check in with yourself.
